description: A-7A-4c-CV US Navy Bureau Number; mapped by Aerial Visuals at the VFW Post 8343 and 11038 site at Waterford; I could not corroborate this Navy airframe in a second source
T-33A-1-LO; was at General Mitchell Field Milwaukee then preserved at Fort Atkinson; Baugher states now on display at Waterford Wisconsin VFW Post 8343

TOS 1968 and served in South Vietnam; converted to AH-1S Modernized ca 1981 and redesignated AH-1F ca September 1988; stored at Fort Drum then allocated 15 June 2001 to VFW Post 11038 Waterford and placed on display by August 2003; Baugher states it is now on a pole at VFW Post 8343 Waterford
